name: anniversary-poster
description: Your story in numbers: a keepsake poster and the dates of your next milestones.

interface.longDescription:
Turn the day you met, your first date or your wedding day into a keepsake "our story in numbers" poster. Zovo Love Story Poster counts how many days you have been together using calendar math (real month lengths and leap years), and adds the years, months and days, the weeks, the full months, the hours (with clock changes when you give a time zone), the full moons you have seen together, the weekends, the leap days and the anniversaries.

It also works out when your next round milestones fall: the 1,000th day, 500 weeks, 100 months, 100,000 hours, the 100th full moon, a billion seconds and the next anniversary, each with its date. Ask "when is our 1,000th day?" or "when is our 100th day?" (Korean-style counting, where the first day is day 1, is available).

Downloads: a printable portrait poster PDF in Letter, A4, A3 or 12 x 18 inches with four colour themes, and a calendar file (ICS) for Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar that reminds you a week before each milestone.

Good for anniversary gifts, wedding anniversaries, Valentine's Day, friendship anniversaries and family milestones.

Limitations: one start date per poster; the start date cannot be in the future (for a countdown to an event, use a countdown tool); dates from 1900 onward; full moon dates are in UTC unless a time zone is given; no photos.
defaultPrompt: Make an 'our story in numbers' poster for Alex & Sam, together since June 14, 2019 (New York), counted to 2026-10-30
We started dating on 2026-08-01 in Seoul. Counting the first day as day 1, when is our 100th day? Today is 2026-10-30
Married Feb 29, 2016 in Lisbon. As of 2026-10-30, how many days married and when are our next milestones?

positive.description: Couple poster with stats and next milestones
positive.prompt: Make an 'our story in numbers' poster for Alex & Sam, together since June 14, 2019 (New York), counted to 2026-10-30
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_anniversary_poster with start_date=2019-06-14, names=Alex & Sam, as_of=2026-10-30, time_zone=America/New_York. Reports 2,695 days together = 7 years, 4 months, 16 days = 385 weeks = 88 full months, 64,680 hours, 92 full moons, 385 weekends, 2 leap days, 7 anniversaries, and next milestones including the 8th anniversary on 2027-06-14 and 3,000 days together on 2027-08-31, with poster PDF and ICS download links.

positive.prompt: We started dating on 2026-08-01 in Seoul. Counting the first day as day 1, when is our 100th day? Today is 2026-10-30
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_anniversary_poster with start_date=2026-08-01, count_first_day=true, time_zone=Asia/Seoul, as_of=2026-10-30. Says today is day 91 and Day 100 together falls on 2026-11-08 (in 9 days), followed by Day 200 on 2027-02-16 and the 1st anniversary on 2027-08-01, with poster PDF and ICS links.

positive.prompt: Married Feb 29, 2016 in Lisbon. As of 2026-10-30, how many days married and when are our next milestones? Poster for Maria and João
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_anniversary_poster with start_date=2016-02-29, occasion=married, names=Maria and João, time_zone=Europe/Lisbon, as_of=2026-10-30. Reports 3,896 days married = 10 years, 8 months, 1 day, 132 full moons, 3 leap days, states that the anniversary is kept on February 28 in non-leap years, and lists 4,000 days married on 2027-02-11 and the 11th anniversary on 2027-02-28.

positive.prompt: First date June 20, 2020 at 7:30 pm in London. How many hours have we been together as of 2026-10-30? A4 poster please
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_anniversary_poster with start_date=2020-06-20, start_time=19:30, time_zone=Europe/London, as_of=2026-10-30, page_size=A4. Reports 2,323 days = 6 years, 4 months, 10 days, 55,753 hours (1 hour more than days x 24 because of the clock change), 79 full moons, and the 7th anniversary on 2027-06-20, with an A4 poster PDF.

positive.prompt: Best friends since September 1, 2010. Make a friendship poster in the sage theme counted to 2026-10-30
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_anniversary_poster with start_date=September 1, 2010, occasion=friends, theme=sage, as_of=2026-10-30. Reports 5,903 days of friendship = 16 years, 1 month, 29 days, 843 weeks, 200 full moons, and next 6,000 days of friendship on 2027-02-04 and 200 months of friendship on 2027-05-01.

negative.description: A countdown to a future event is out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant answers directly or suggests a countdown tool.
negative.prompt: How many days until our wedding on June 6, 2027?

negative.description: A single person's age is not a relationship poster. Expected: the tool is not called.
negative.prompt: How old am I in days if I was born on March 3, 1990?

negative.description: Writing a love letter is out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant writes the letter itself.
negative.prompt: Write a romantic letter for my wife for our anniversary

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: exact days, weeks, months, years, hours, full moons, weekends, leap days and anniversaries since a date; next round milestones with dates; printable poster PDF (Letter, A4, A3, 12x18 in) and a milestone calendar file.

pl-PL.subtitle: Wasze wspólne dni w druku
pl-PL.description:
Zamień dzień, w którym się poznaliście, pierwszą randkę lub dzień ślubu w pamiątkowy plakat „nasza historia w liczbach”. Zovo Love Story Poster dokładnie liczy dni razem, a także lata, miesiące i dni, tygodnie, godziny (ze zmianami czasu, jeśli podasz strefę czasową), wspólne pełnie Księżyca, weekendy, dni przestępne i rocznice.

Podaje też daty kolejnych okrągłych rocznic: 1000. dnia, 500 tygodni, 100 miesięcy, 100 000 godzin, 100. pełni i miliarda sekund.

Do pobrania: plakat PDF (Letter, A4, A3 lub 12 x 18 cali) w czterech motywach kolorystycznych oraz plik kalendarza (ICS) z przypomnieniem przed każdym kamieniem milowym.

Ograniczenia: jedna data początkowa na plakat; data nie może być w przyszłości; daty od 1900 roku.

de-DE.subtitle: Eure Tage zu zweit als Poster
de-DE.description:
Macht aus dem Tag eures Kennenlernens, dem ersten Date oder dem Hochzeitstag ein Erinnerungsposter „Unsere Geschichte in Zahlen“. Zovo Love Story Poster zählt die gemeinsamen Tage exakt, dazu Jahre, Monate und Tage, Wochen, Stunden (mit Zeitumstellung, wenn eine Zeitzone angegeben ist), gemeinsame Vollmonde, Wochenenden, Schalttage und Jahrestage.

Es berechnet auch die Daten der nächsten runden Meilensteine: der 1.000. Tag, 500 Wochen, 100 Monate, 100.000 Stunden, der 100. Vollmond und eine Milliarde Sekunden.

Downloads: ein Poster-PDF (Letter, A4, A3 oder 12 x 18 Zoll) in vier Farbthemen und eine Kalenderdatei (ICS) mit einer Erinnerung vor jedem Meilenstein.

Grenzen: ein Startdatum pro Poster; das Datum darf nicht in der Zukunft liegen; Daten ab 1900.

es-ES.subtitle: Vuestros días juntos, impresos
es-ES.description:
Convierte el día en que os conocisteis, vuestra primera cita o el día de la boda en un póster recuerdo «nuestra historia en números». Zovo Love Story Poster cuenta con exactitud los días juntos, además de años, meses y días, semanas, horas (con cambios de hora si indicas una zona horaria), lunas llenas compartidas, fines de semana, días bisiestos y aniversarios.

También calcula las fechas de los próximos hitos redondos: el día 1.000, 500 semanas, 100 meses, 100.000 horas, la luna llena número 100 y mil millones de segundos.

Descargas: un póster PDF (Carta, A4, A3 o 12 x 18 pulgadas) con cuatro temas de color y un archivo de calendario (ICS) con un aviso antes de cada hito.

Limitaciones: una fecha de inicio por póster; la fecha no puede ser futura; fechas desde 1900.

fr-FR.subtitle: Vos jours ensemble, à imprimer
fr-FR.description:
Transformez le jour de votre rencontre, votre premier rendez-vous ou votre mariage en affiche souvenir « notre histoire en chiffres ». Zovo Love Story Poster compte exactement les jours passés ensemble, ainsi que les années, mois et jours, les semaines, les heures (avec les changements d'heure si vous indiquez un fuseau horaire), les pleines lunes partagées, les week-ends, les jours bissextiles et les anniversaires.

Il calcule aussi les dates des prochains caps ronds : le 1 000e jour, 500 semaines, 100 mois, 100 000 heures, la 100e pleine lune et un milliard de secondes.

Téléchargements : une affiche PDF (Letter, A4, A3 ou 12 x 18 pouces) en quatre thèmes de couleur et un fichier de calendrier (ICS) avec un rappel avant chaque cap.

Limites : une date de départ par affiche ; la date ne peut pas être dans le futur ; dates à partir de 1900.

ja-JP.subtitle: ふたりの日々を数字のポスターに
ja-JP.description:
出会った日、初デート、結婚式の日から「ふたりの物語を数字で」記念ポスターを作ります。Zovo Love Story Poster は一緒に過ごした日数を正確に数え、年・月・日、週、時間（タイムゾーンを指定すると夏時間も反映）、一緒に見た満月の回数、週末、うるう日、記念日の回数も表示します。

1000日目、500週、100か月、10万時間、100回目の満月、10億秒など、次の節目の日付も計算します。韓国式（初日を1日目とする）の数え方にも対応しています。

ダウンロード：印刷用ポスターPDF（Letter、A4、A3、12×18インチ、4つのカラーテーマ）と、各節目の前にお知らせするカレンダーファイル（ICS）。

制限：ポスター1枚につき開始日は1つ、未来の日付は不可、1900年以降の日付に対応。

pt-BR.subtitle: Seus dias juntos em um pôster
pt-BR.description:
Transforme o dia em que vocês se conheceram, o primeiro encontro ou o dia do casamento em um pôster de lembrança "nossa história em números". O Zovo Love Story Poster conta com exatidão os dias juntos, além de anos, meses e dias, semanas, horas (com mudanças de horário quando você informa um fuso), luas cheias compartilhadas, fins de semana, dias bissextos e aniversários.

Também calcula as datas dos próximos marcos redondos: o 1.000º dia, 500 semanas, 100 meses, 100.000 horas, a 100ª lua cheia e um bilhão de segundos.

Downloads: um pôster em PDF (Carta, A4, A3 ou 12 x 18 polegadas) em quatro temas de cores e um arquivo de calendário (ICS) com um lembrete antes de cada marco.

Limitações: uma data de início por pôster; a data não pode estar no futuro; datas a partir de 1900.
